texts.preamble: Nagendra Singh & Anr vs . Food Safety Officer on 17 April, 2023 In The Court Of Sh. Harjyot Singh Bhalla Additional Sessions Judge-04 Patiala House Courts, New Delhi In The Matter Of: Nagendra Singh & Anr Vs. Food Safety Officer Cnr No. Dlnd01-009556-2022 Cr. Rev. No. 593/2022 1. Nagendra Singh 2 . M/s Thea Kitchen Private Limited
texts.facts: 3. The sample in the present was taken on 11.06.2019. 4. A perusal of the complaint in the present case reveals that in paragraph no.14, the complainant has, while making allegations against the accused, indicated the specific Regulations which seem to have been violated by accused by adding synthetic colour Tartrazine yellow to the food product. The paragraph no.14 of the complaint is reproduced hereinbelow for ease of reference: Nagendra Singh & Anr vs . Food Safety Officer on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199432149/ 1 Part investigation was carried out by Sh. Bal Mukund, the then Food Safety Officer and then file was handed over to the undersigned on 21.10.19. Ms. Kapil Malik conducted the further investigation investigation and after being satisfied found the under mentioned persons responsible for day to day business and as such they are in-charge of and responsible for the conduct of business. Thus, the accused persons have violated the provisions of Section 26 (1), Section 26 (2) (i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 read with Section 3 (1) (zz) (v) (vii) & (viii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, alongwith violation of Section 27 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Accused also violated Regulation No.3.1.2(1) read with 3.1.2(6) of The Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additive) Regulations, 2011 which is punishable under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 5. Ld. Counsel for the accused has argued that the said provision i.e. Regulation 3.1.2 (1) and 3.1.2 (6) of The Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additive) Regulations, 2011 has since been amended w.e.f. 08.09.2016 and substituted and a copy of the Gazette notification has also been placed on record today. 6. I have perused the same. The effect of the amendment is that the said provision 3.1.2 (1) and 3.1.2 (6) have been omitted. On the basis of the complaint and other documents, prima facie, there is sufficient material to proceed against the accused persons.
